A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same VLMLight research. All 25 pages in each version, including figures, tables, equations, Algorithm 1, and Appendices A–E, are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original traffic-simulation experiments at three intersections, baseline comparisons, agent ablations, model comparisons, inference timings, and qualitative case outcomes.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experimental results in Section 4 and Appendices C–D, including quantitative comparisons and traffic-control case studies.

M1.justification: The perception, meta-controller, RL policy, reasoning agents, prompts, and Algorithm 1 remain unchanged. The validation and RL fallback emphasized in v2 were already present in v1.

E1.justification: Both evaluate Songdo, Yau Ma Tei, and Massy under the same routine and emergency-vehicle scenarios. SynTraC is newly discussed as related work, not used for training or evaluation.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains FixTime, Webster, MaxPressure, IntelliLight, UniTSA, A-CATs, 3DQN-TSCC, CCDA, and Vanilla-VLM. The model alternatives in Tables 5–7 also remain unchanged; newly cited Traffic-R1 is not evaluated.

E3.justification: The 20-minute training/10-minute testing split, signal timing, four evaluation metrics, model configurations, and training budgets are unchanged. No additional evaluation protocol is introduced.

E4.justification: Both retain the same agent ablations, model-sensitivity comparisons, inference-time analysis, RL convergence curves, and three appendix case studies. No new robustness test or supplementary analysis is added.

E5.justification: Table 1 retains identical plus/minus reporting. Neither version provides additional run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or explanations of uncertainty estimation.

E6.justification: Figure 3 revises two counts in the illustrated Phase-2 output: T1 left-turn vehicles change from 2 to 3, and T2 right-turn vehicles from 3 to 2. These are localized example-output edits; the benchmark, ablation, model-comparison, and timing results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and Equations 1–11 are unchanged apart from spacing. The added safety explanation supplies no new formal assumption, derivation, theorem, or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same simulator novelty, dual-branch control, emergency-waiting reduction, and routine-performance claims. Adding 'Safety-Critical' to the title emphasizes a scope already explicit in v1.

C2.justification: Appendix A.2 newly states that validation combined with RL fallback safeguards against noise and reasoning errors, ensuring feasible and safety-compliant actions. This adds an explicit protective interpretation of existing components; the limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The simulator version, hardware, PPO implementation and hyperparameters, input encoding, prompt templates, and release statements are retained. The added fallback explanation discloses no new implementation procedure or setting.

R1.justification: v2 adds Traffic-R1 and SynTraC references. Section 5 expands the simulator discussion to describe SynTraC's CARLA-based imagery and its stated limitations in intersection coverage and camera configurability, providing a more specific comparison with prior visual TSC work.

P1.justification: Changes are localized to the title and an affiliation, expanded related-work and algorithm explanations, and small punctuation/capitalization corrections. The overall narrative and section sequence are retained.

P2.justification: Table 4 moves from page 19 to page 20, and appendix headings, prompt figures, and algorithm spacing reflow. Table 2's caption punctuation is corrected. No figures or tables are added, removed, or substantially redesigned.

improvement.justification: The added SynTraC comparison and Traffic-R1 citation modestly improve research positioning, while Appendix A.2 clarifies the existing fallback's intended protective role. The gains are limited: empirical support is unchanged, and Figure 3 fixes the T1 count but introduces a T2 count mismatch with its unchanged scene description.
